title: Utility Transfer Gap on Move Day
dataSources: Move checklists (`move:checklist`), USPS change-of-address (`usps:change`), mover quotes (`mover:quote`), utility transfers (`utility:transfer`), and box inventories (`box:inventory`).
app: Move checklist task exports, USPS change-of-address confirmations, mover quote comparisons, utility transfer logs, and box inventory scans forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=utility:transfer utility_type=* transfer_status=* move_date=*
| eval gap=if(transfer_status!="active" AND transfer_date<=move_date,1,0)
| where gap=1
| table utility_type transfer_status move_date transfer_date
description: Flags utilities that were not active by the recorded move-in date.
value: Arriving without power, water, or internet turns the first night into an unnecessary crisis.
implementation: Include `move_date`, `transfer_date`, and `transfer_status` on each utility event and verify one week ahead.
visualization: Table of utilities not active by move date.
grandmaExplanation: It spots utilities that were not turned on by the day you actually moved in.
